He made the declaration during the presidential engagement in Jos, Plateau State, where he said key political stakeholders in the state were united behind the president and determined to support his second-term ambition.
He attributed the growing political unity in the state to deliberate planning and confidence in Tinubu’s leadership, expressing optimism about the president’s prospects ahead of the 2027 general elections. he former Zamfara State governor commended Tinubu for his commitment to national development, noting that Plateau State appreciated the administration’s developmental initiatives and the appointment of one of its sons as national chairman of the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC).
Describing Tinubu as the captain of both the party and the nation, Yari expressed confidence in his leadership and the prospects of continued national progress under his administration.
Yari acknowledged that insecurity was a longstanding challenge that had developed over several years.
He, however, said the Tinubu administration had prioritised national security in its manifesto and was making deliberate efforts to strengthen the country’s security architecture and protect communities across the federation.
The APC chieftain also praised the president’s economic reforms, highlighting the increase in federation account revenue from approximately N732 billion in June 2023 to allocations now running into trillions of naira.
He commended Tinubu’s courage and vision, describing the growth in revenue as an important part of the administration’s efforts to reposition the Nigerian economy.
Yari further reaffirmed the party’s commitment to delivering on the eight key areas of the Renewed Hope manifesto, stressing the need for the government and the party to remain accountable for their promises.
He expressed optimism that significant progress would be recorded by 2031, while urging sustained commitment to the president’s vision for Nigeria.
